texts.label: text
texts.orig: We consider a single-cell massive multiple-input multipleoutput (MIMO) system consists of a BS equipped with a uniform planar array (UPA) comprising M = M z M x antennas, where M x and M z denote the number of horizontal and vertical antennas, respectively. The BS serves K singleantenna users. Orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) modulation is employed. The number of subcarriers is N c , and N v subcarriers are allocated for data transmission. Each time slot contains N b OFDM symbols, and the channel parameters remain constant within each OFDM symbol but vary across different symbols.
